name: instagram
tagline: Publish and Monitor Instagram from QuoxCORE
description: Governed Instagram professional account publishing and monitoring: a single image, video, or reel by public https URL, media and account reads, media/account insights, comment reads, comment replies, and rolling 24-hour publishing quota. Instagram is its own plugin SKU on the SAME shared Meta credential the Facebook plugin uses: one vaulted long-lived Page access token powers both, discovered automatically from the linked Facebook Page.
shortDescription: Instagram publishing, insights, and comment management on the shared Meta credential.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Publish a single image, video, or reel with a governed, human-approved flow
One shared Meta credential powers both Facebook and Instagram
Read account and media insights: reach, saved, likes, comments, shares, views
Reply to comments with a human approval gate
Track the rolling 24-hour publishing quota before you hit the cap
Media grid dashboard with thumbnails and engagement counts

publishing.name: Media Publishing
publishing.description: Publish a single image, video, or reel to an Instagram professional account by public https URL. Every publish files a human approval card first, then runs the create-container -> poll -> publish flow.

discovery.name: Shared Credential Discovery
discovery.description: Resolves the Instagram professional account linked to a Facebook Page automatically, off the same vaulted Meta token the Facebook plugin uses. No second credential to paste.

insights.name: Media & Account Insights
insights.description: Read per-media and account-level insights: reach, saved, likes, comments, shares, views, and follower count across day, week, or 28-day windows.

comments.name: Comment Management
comments.description: Read comments on any media item and reply with a human approval gate.

quota.name: Publishing Quota Tracking
quota.description: Surfaces the rolling 24-hour API publishing quota (hard-capped at 100 posts by Meta) before you hit the limit.

specialist.name: INSTAGRAM
specialist.description: Instagram publishing and monitoring specialist on the shared Meta credential
capabilities: Publish a single image, video, or reel (human approval required)
Discover the linked Instagram professional account
Read and reply to comments (human approval required)

requirements.external: A Meta app with a long-lived Facebook Page access token (stored in vault, shared with the Facebook plugin) and an Instagram professional account linked to that Page

igUserId.label: Instagram Account ID
igUserId.description: The Instagram professional account ID, resolved by the setup wizard's discover_account step (not typed in by hand)

futureFeatures: Meta Ads insights and management (separate META-ADS plugin)
OAuth broker sign-in (credentials are a pasted long-lived token by design for now, shared with Facebook)

changes: Governed single image/video/reel publishing (human approval required)
Shared Meta credential discovery via the linked Facebook Page
